description: /explore-and-resolve drives a live UI, which the harness has no stand-in for, so this case asserts only what holds without one: with the app declared (Admin UI: playwright, a collection runner) but no .env, the command stops before app-explorer and resolve-markers, lists the three credential variables it needs, and writes nothing.
setup: printf '%s\n' '- **Admin UI:** playwright' '- **API test collection:** .sources/demo.postman_collection.json' '- **API collection runner:** newman' >> CLAUDE.md && mkdir -p .sources && printf '{"info":{"name":"demo"},"item":[]}\n' > .sources/demo.postman_collection.json && git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'
